KeyPassages: 1 Chronicles 7:5; 2 Chronicles 17:18; Genesis 5:26; Song of Solomon 6:8
BiblicalUsage: Eighty counts long lives, great armies, and queens. Methuselah lived seven hundred eighty and two years after Lamech, the families of Issachar numbered fourscore and seven thousand valiant men, and Jehozabad stood with a hundred and fourscore thousand ready for war. The Song counts threescore queens and fourscore concubines.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe fourscore is the measure of a full life and a full army. Long years and great numbers both belong to God, and I hold that He counts both.
RelatedBooks: 1 Chronicles; 2 Chronicles; Genesis; Song of Solomon
